vectors.name: valid_complete_package
vectors.rationale: Complete synthetic nested package with derived registry and external manifests.

vectors.name: raw_terminal_lf
vectors.rationale: Raw declaration bytes forbid a terminal LF.

vectors.name: raw_invalid_utf8
vectors.rationale: Raw declarations are strict UTF-8.

vectors.name: raw_duplicate_object_key
vectors.rationale: Raw declaration objects reject duplicate keys.

vectors.name: raw_json_number
vectors.rationale: Raw declarations forbid JSON numbers.

vectors.name: raw_non_ascii_key
vectors.rationale: Raw declaration keys are ASCII.

vectors.name: raw_empty_key
vectors.rationale: Raw declaration keys are nonempty.

vectors.name: raw_reordered_object_keys
vectors.rationale: Raw objects must be in encoded JSON-string key order.

vectors.name: missing_grammar_role
vectors.rationale: Every package has the one literal grammar role.

vectors.name: duplicate_source_role
vectors.rationale: Each source role occurs once.

vectors.name: fixed_grammar_mutation
vectors.rationale: The grammar role is one exact published literal.

vectors.name: closed_schema_role_extra_field
vectors.rationale: Schema roles have exact closed object fields.

vectors.name: unknown_type_kind
vectors.rationale: Type expressions use the closed kind grammar.

vectors.name: duplicate_schema_field
vectors.rationale: Schema field names are unique.

vectors.name: unresolved_model_reference
vectors.rationale: Every ModelRef must resolve in the schema closure.

vectors.name: nested_model_cycle
vectors.rationale: Transitive model dependencies must be acyclic.

vectors.name: direct_model_self_reference
vectors.rationale: A model cannot reference itself.

vectors.name: unresolved_enum_reference
vectors.rationale: EnumRef must resolve in its reachable closure.

vectors.name: duplicate_enum_identity
vectors.rationale: Enum identities are unique in a closure.

vectors.name: union_discriminator_not_declared
vectors.rationale: Every union alternative declares the discriminator as a singleton matching literal.

vectors.name: optional_field_set_not_exact
vectors.rationale: Optional policy rows must equal schema fields.

vectors.name: numeric_wrapper_without_row
vectors.rationale: Every direct numeric wrapper requires one numeric row.

vectors.name: decimal_numeric_encoding_id_missing
vectors.rationale: Decimal numeric rows require a non-null encoding spec identifier.

vectors.name: decimal_numeric_wrong_owner
vectors.rationale: A numeric wrapper names its direct owning schema field.

vectors.name: decimal_numeric_inverted_range
vectors.rationale: Decimal lower bounds cannot exceed upper bounds.

vectors.name: binary64_forbidden_numeric_members
vectors.rationale: Binary64 policy rows require every decimal-only member to be null.

vectors.name: integrity_policy_unknown_member
vectors.rationale: Digest/signature policies have a closed member set.

vectors.name: decoder_wrong_root_kind
vectors.rationale: Decoder roles require typed_root_kind=model.

vectors.name: upcast_must_be_null_only
vectors.rationale: Profile-3 has no upcast implementation route.

vectors.name: registry_entry_substitution
vectors.rationale: Registry entries must equal independently derived entry commitments.

vectors.name: decoder_manifest_hash_substitution
vectors.rationale: A selected whole-file digest must equal its unmodified bytes.

vectors.name: decoder_manifest_row_order
vectors.rationale: Decoder source rows are ordered by decoder and source-file ID.

vectors.name: decoder_manifest_path_escape
vectors.rationale: Decoder source paths are root-contained whole-file paths.

vectors.name: publication_role_hash_substitution
vectors.rationale: Publication manifest role digests bind raw source bytes.

vectors.name: publication_role_order
vectors.rationale: Publication source-role rows use stable role ordering.

vectors.name: decoder_path_absolute
vectors.rationale: Decoder source paths use closed ASCII slash segments.

vectors.name: decoder_path_backslash
vectors.rationale: Decoder source paths use closed ASCII slash segments.

vectors.name: decoder_path_dot
vectors.rationale: Decoder source paths use closed ASCII slash segments.

vectors.name: decoder_path_percent
vectors.rationale: Decoder source paths use closed ASCII slash segments.

vectors.name: decoder_duplicate_source_id
vectors.rationale: Decoder/source-file identities are unique.

vectors.name: decoder_conflicting_shared_path
vectors.rationale: Shared paths require identical source IDs and bytes.

vectors.name: decoder_unknown_extra_source_row
vectors.rationale: Every source-manifest decoder row is selected by a declared decoder.

vectors.name: decoder_source_file_missing
vectors.rationale: Every manifest-selected source file must exist.

vectors.name: decoder_manifest_profile_change
vectors.rationale: Decoder source manifests bind the profile identity.

vectors.name: decoder_manifest_terminal_lf
vectors.rationale: Decoder source manifest is canonical raw JSON without terminal LF.

vectors.name: publication_manifest_terminal_lf
vectors.rationale: Publication manifest is canonical raw JSON without terminal LF.

vectors.name: publication_decoder_manifest_digest_substitution
vectors.rationale: Publication commits the exact decoder source manifest raw SHA-256.

vectors.name: valid_source_without_terminal_lf
vectors.rationale: Whole-file decoder source bytes preserve a source file with no terminal LF.

vectors.name: decoder_file_symlink
vectors.rationale: A decoder manifest must reject a symlinked whole-file source even when its bytes and SHA-256 match.

vectors.name: decoder_directory_symlink
vectors.rationale: A decoder manifest must reject traversal through a directory symlink even when it resolves beneath the source root.

vectors.name: generated_namespace_source
vectors.rationale: The reserved observation_registry_sources namespace is never eligible decoder-source input.

vectors.name: generated_namespace_nested_source
vectors.rationale: The reserved observation_registry_sources namespace remains excluded at nested depth.

vectors.name: decoder_source_root_symlink
vectors.rationale: The configured canonical decoder-source root itself must not be a symlink.
